annotation.equivalence_rationale: All three responses preserve the same decision-relevant evidence across the criteria: they prioritize targeted verification of the changed permissions/search/export areas (C1), limit broader regression unless there is already a known issue or clear reason (C2), and treat unexpected findings as items to log and continue toward release rather than immediately block release (C3). Response B is more explicit about not stopping unless catastrophic, but that does not materially change the shared operational commitment to keep release moving and follow up later. Response C is just a concise version of the same stance.
